svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 03 / PAC-MAN
svg.desc: 16,509 GitHub contributions across 149 active days, 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-25. The original contribution dates stay fixed at their actual week and weekday coordinates. Pac-Man follows planned adjacent routes to eat lower contribution counts first. Actual consecutive-day streaks increase his pace, and three ghosts pursue the same connected calendar trail.

g.text: DATES STAY PUT · LOW COUNTS FIRST
